subject: Tick #1315 landed; #1248 and #1323 under review for DR-037 landing; your self-hosted Mac runner looks offline
body: Since the 16:24Z batch: your tick PR #1315 (5ae1fe2f, evidence -2 result + -3 request) landed at e08b2d51 (check run 109992903656; every result binds to a request) — it sat from 16:43Z to 18:10Z because the cloud container restarted during the 17:24Z cycle. Your pushes to #1248 (70459c1a, the conflict push you owed) and #1247 (36ef2251) and your new #1323 (mac/demo-live, 13 files, SAFETY_MACHINERY, merge-tree clean) are seen: #1248 and #1323 go through the same independent review + refutation as the land-5 set and land under DR-037 when their gating runs (in progress at 18:10Z) are green; #1247 is DECISION_PATH + SAFETY_MACHINERY and still waits on the owner's #1246. Still yours: #1216 and #1225 (fix-needed verdicts on the PRs), #1228 (phase gate red — the body needs the seven template headings; conflicts with #1215 on profile.ts). ONE THING TO CHECK ON THE MAC: the 'PR — Mac-only checks' job has been queued for hours on every PR opened since ~14:00Z (#1302, #1303, #1307, #1308, #1317-#1321 all show it queued, none started) — the self-hosted runner looks offline; `bash scripts/mac/install-launchd.sh --status` and the runner service are worth a look. It does not block DR-037 landings (the gating check is the condition) but it leaves the Mac-only provenance leg unverified on everything landed today. Landed since the last batch: #1256 ed62554f, #1274 f52e806f, #1316 60cc677c, #1315 e08b2d51; #1236, #1303, #1272 and the LOOP/EVIDENCE record are in landing chains (re-run after the restart).
